briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch escalates AGI race as Meta and xAI counter with frontier releases

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI landscape intensifies with multiple frontier model drops this week amid record quarterly funding. Geopolitical stakes rise as US and China accelerate compute deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with multimodal reasoning breakthroughs. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Meta's Llama 4 follow closely, while xAI deploys Grok-4 for real-time inference.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement highlights supply chain risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 500k units shipped. Google and Microsoft announce $40B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems outpace single-model scaling by 2027?
